curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach vision and hearing first, then fatigue and rest rules, then the three kinds of distraction
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on senses, rest stops, naps and distraction kinds
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on sleep hours, stop intervals, nap length and distraction channels

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach how emotion clouds driving, then aggressive driving versus road rage, then how aging drivers seek evaluation
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on emotion, aggression, rage response and aging evaluation
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on cooling off, rage responses and evaluation triggers

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach how alcohol and drugs impair driving, then zero tolerance, then medicine and illegal drug rules
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on impairment, zero tolerance and medicine labels
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on impairment effects, youth rules and drug-driving penalties

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the DUI definition, then implied consent and testing, then penalties, aggravators and interlock rules
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on DUI limits, implied consent and penalties
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on DUI thresholds, refusal consequences and aggravators
